fato_historico: 1942: Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands becomes the first reigning queen to address a joint session of the United States Congress.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to channel the strength of a sovereign leader today, Taurus. Just as voices of power once echoed across distant halls to inspire unity, you may find your own voice holds newfound authority. Consider expressing your truth with gentle dignity, as this energy supports building bridges and standing firmly yet graciously in your own personal power.
frase_do_dia: Stand tall with grace, for your voice has the power to inspire the world.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of abundance and intuitive wisdom in daily life.
conselho: Trust your inner authority when making decisions that impact your long-term path today.
